units: <cite ref="Eruvin 6a:5">Erub. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>מבוי ע׳</he> a winding alley; Y. ib. I, 18ᶜ bot. <he>ע׳ ומפולש</he> winding but open on both sides.
Y. Dem. II, beg. 22ᵇ ע׳ הוא the cumin of Cyprus is crooked; a. e.—Fem. עֲקוּמָּה.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 4:1:4">Y. Taan. IV, beg. 67ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>הות אצבעתיה ע׳</he> had a crooked finger; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 4:8:2">Y. Meg. IV, 75ᵇ</cite> bot. <cite ref="P01179"><he>עֲקִימָה</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>עֲקוּמּוֹת</he>. Bab.
<cite ref="Megillah 24b:9">Meg. 24ᵇ</cite> (<he>ידיו</he>) <he>ע׳ עקושות לא וכ׳</he> if his hands (fingers) are curved (inward) or bent (sideways), he must not pronounce the priestly benediction.
